text.en: Shoot tainted slugs that burrow into combatants. Stacking enough slugs causes them all to explode, stunning surviving combatants. Strong against  [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions.

Intrinsically <unstoppable/>Anti-Unstoppable, but only Slug explosions stun <unstoppable/>Unstoppable champions.

Hits embed Explosive Slugs into the target. Target death or embedding a fifth slug causes all slugs to explode, each dealing <pve 203 /> <pvp [45] /> damage in a 1? meter radius.
